prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. One production animation asset generated as ONE COMPLETE HORIZONTAL STRIP OF EXACTLY EIGHT full-character drawings in EIGHT equal slots, ONE row. Image 1 is the official Game Studio transparent edit canvas containing the approved sprite in the first slot; image 2 is the same locked original at readable size. Keep the original character, three-quarter LEFT facing camera, same palette, proportions, fine outlines and soft HD painterly shading. Do NOT change to pixel art or redesign the face. Draw all eight phases together. Same body volume and head size in all frames. Transparent alpha canvas with ample space between frames. No scene, text, numbering, grid, border, shadows, floor or dust. No frame overlap or clipping. Draw the whole motion, not tiny changes to a static sprite. The character is the same small ivory mint-tinted dew rabbit with large long leaf-like ears, mint inner ears, dew drops, green eyes and fluffy chest. Make a CLEAR LOCOMOTION HOP cycle IN PLACE toward LEFT. Keep the original head, fur colors, eye positions, ear shapes, tail and body volume. Eight chronological phases: 1 crouched preparation, hind legs folded under body and forefeet on the shared ground baseline; 2 hind feet press and push back against that baseline, hips begin extending upward; 3 takeoff, body rises and forefeet fold under chest while hind legs extend behind; 4 airborne apex with hind legs tucked and forepaws starting to reach forward, ears trail naturally; 5 descent with forepaws reaching down/left and hind legs still tucked; 6 FOREPAW LANDING on the same ground baseline, elbows flex as body accepts weight, rear feet not yet landed; 7 hind feet arrive underneath and the body compresses naturally; 8 recovery toward the initial crouch. Show the actual changed limb silhouettes and ground/contact phases with new drawings. Do not simply move a static seated rabbit up/down or stretch the same art. Keep a common floor baseline across grounded phases and preserve the real airborne height in phases3-5; do not individually bottom-align airborne poses.
